title: MerlinProgram
description: A dynamic, search-driven Merlin command: a MerlinOption whose `eventName` is `super-daemon-run-program`. Selecting its row enters program mode; `value.program(input, values)` is re-run (debounced ~150ms) on every keystroke and the MerlinOption rows it returns replace the list. Programs are usually lazy-loaded via a dynamic import() of a createXProgram(context) factory. All option fields and the program `value` shape come from merlin-option.schema.json.
